neighbours.label: ' was' or ' the' right after a subject in an expository clause (broad)
fire: It is safe to assume that the author's tongue was firmly in his cheek.
In the legal profession, information is the key to success.
Caring about this question was invented at a small university.
The answer to the riddle was hidden in the first line.
The cause of the fire was a faulty heater in the kitchen.
In this business, timing is the secret to winning contracts.
The original manuscript was lost during the war.
For most students, practice is the path to good grades.
quiet: It is safe to assume that the author wrote this as a joke.
In the legal profession, people read a great deal of material.
People started caring about this question at a small university.
We found the answer to the riddle in the first line.
A faulty heater in the kitchen started the fire.
In this business, good timing helps you win contracts.
Somebody lost the original manuscript during the war.
Most students get good grades if they practise often.
